section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1998
title: 2.1.1 The number of suicides reported in the country during 1998 was 1,04,713 as against 95,829 suicides in 1997 and 88,241 in 1996. There has been a significant increase of 9.3 percent in the Suicides in the country in 1998 as compared to 1997. During the decade, 1988-1998, the incidence of suicides rose at a compound growth rate of 4.33 percent as against the population which had a compound growth rate of only 2.01 percent (Table – 14). 2.1.2 The decadal incidence (change in 1998 over 1988) recorded an increase of 62.9 percent (from 64,270 suicides in 1988 to 1,04,713 suicides in 1998). Infact, the increase in incidence of Suicide was reported each year during the decade except years 1995 and 1996. During the decade 1988-1998, the population grew by 21.9 percent and the rate of suicide increased by 33.7 percent. The rate of suicide during 1998 was 10.8 as against 10.0 in 1997 and 8.1 in 1988.
